# Session State

Compatibility handoff only; do not load by default or treat as current truth. Durable state belongs in `.github/ai/AI_WORKING_STATE.md` or the relevant domain document.

Use this file only when the same task must continue in another session and important transient findings are not yet recorded elsewhere. Note the objective, uncommitted files, verification status, and blocker; clear it after durable state is updated. Completed committed tasks need no handoff.

The former milestone diary is preserved in Git history through commit `a257101`; its durable evidence remains under `docs/`.
